get.description: Events: hello (server_time, instance, resumed), layer (module_id, fetched_at, version), snapshot (a module's full entity rows) and delta (upserts and removes since the previous version). Event ids are opaque; send the last one back in Last-Event-ID to resume from the server's recent buffer, or get fresh snapshots when it is too old.

parameters.name: entities

schema.description: Comma separated entity module ids that get snapshot and delta events. Leave it out for every enabled entity module, or send it empty for none.
